name: drawing_dimensions_holes_and_chamfer
why: ENTRY GT11. On 25/9/2026 we were asked to LOOK at a dimensioned drawing, and the drawing — made only with the operations of the bridge, with the bench all green — had four defects that no expectation asked about: the holes were not dimensioned, the chamfer was an oblique 7.071 with the 5/75 chain next to the 80, the 10 and the 120 appeared in two views, and the numbers of the vertical dimensions sat ABOVE the extension lines (the model-to-sheet transformation was transposed and lost the translation). This case redoes the same plate and demands the right drawing, view by view.
defect_caught: A dimension that is missing, or that is there twice. The earlier expectations asked for the millimetres of the dimensions PLACED — and so a drawing without the holes and with the 120 repeated was green. Here we also ask what must NOT be there: the 120 in the view from above, the 10 in the side one, the hypotenuse of the chamfer, the strokes shortened by the chamfer.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V1, V2, V3 as the state of the drawing numbers them: the NAMES depend on the language of SOLIDWORKS («Drawing View2» here). `standard_views` puts them in the order front, top, side — measured on the demonstration drawing, where the view with the holes is the second.

expect.tolerance_why: 96000 minus 4 x pi x 4^2 x 10 = 4 x 502.655: the calculation has pi in it, and the hundredth is the rounding. Three holes only would give 94491.03

steps._the_edge_by_where_it_is: The top back edge, named by COORDINATES (y = 10, z = -40): among the four long edges 120 no other field tells it apart, and `n=` would choose by an order that is not declared.

steps._it_is_6_here_too: The front view shows 4 edges, so «count: 6» takes all 4 of them as before. It is here because this is the step the bench compares the refusal on V9 with (the twin is the FIRST successful step of the same operation), and a twin must have at least one argument in common with the refusal — the first run stopped it as a «fake twin».

IDisplayDimension~SetText.html returns nothing and says «This method does not support hole callouts», and until library 0.140.0 nothing checked what it wrote: the expectation below asked the COUNT of the holes, which is 4 whatever the callout says. ONE callout for the four equal holes: the defect was that the holes were not dimensioned at all. This is the number of holes in the group (the geometry), not the text on the sheet: that is «prefix_read» above
the diameter re-read from the callout, not the one I thought I had asked for
the POSITIONS of the holes, in parallel from the reference edges: 15 and 105 from the left edge, 15 and 65 from the bottom one. Without the position a hole on a drawing cannot be made
DIMENSIONING REPEATED BETWEEN VIEWS: the 120 is already in V1. Before, it appeared twice
the counterpart: the 120 is not missing because of a fault, it was skipped and the operation says so
the callout and the four positions (two columns, two rows), counted before and after. «contains 15» alone would let the 105 pass too: it is the exact number that closes the hole
